title: Agent liveness
responsibility: Determines whether an agent finished, lost its process, exceeded its heartbeat allowance or is still working.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.agent
inputs.description: Registration and latest heartbeat facts, heartbeat allowance in seconds, optional process identity, and any final completed or failed record. Dates are expected to be parseable strings.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.now
inputs.description: Time of the assessment in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; a heartbeat is stale only when its age is greater than the allowance.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.processOf
inputs.description: Lookup for the named process, returning existence and start time. Called only for an unfinished agent with a non-null pid; undefined existence means the process could not be checked.

outputs.name: agentLiveness
outputs.description: State and explanation: a final status wins, an absent or reused process is gone, an overdue heartbeat is stale, and otherwise the agent is working.
